denan.g: this (לְמָא דְנָן = why is it that)

ulpan.g: instruction, teaching (בֵּית אוּלְפָנָא = house of study)

shabed.g: to subjugate, bring under (here: to bring under the Torah)

shlm.g: to be finished, come to an end

ahd.g: to hold, seize; to close (a door)

tm.g: to let taste, give to taste

dilhen.g: (כְּיוֹם דִּלְהֵן) right now, this very day

qwm2.g: to establish, fulfil; (Itpa'al) to endure, last

gly.g: to uncover, reveal; to go into exile; (passive participle) revealed, known

nht.g: to go down; (Af'el) to bring down

shry.g: to dwell, rest; to begin; (Af'el) to settle, place

meimra.g: word; (of Hashem) His Word, the Memra

saad.g: support, help (בְּסַעֲדָךְ = with you, at your side)

mattara.g: charge, guard (נְטַר מַטְּרַת = kept the charge)

esaq.g: matter, affair (עַל עֵיסַק = on account of)

hzy.g: to see; (Itpe'el) to be seen, appear

yhd.g: to set apart; (participle) the distinguished one

ad.g: until, up to; (עַד לָא) before, not yet

push.g: to be extensive, increase; (here) be fruitful

gzr.g: to cut; to make (a covenant); to circumcise; (Itpe'el, Itpa'al) to be circumcised

lhod.g: alone, only (with a suffix: by himself)

qdm2.g: to rise early; to go early

lbsh.g: to wear, put on; (Af'el) to clothe

shr.g: to go around, surround; (Itpa'al) to turn; to sit up (at a meal)

qrb.g: to come near; (Pa'el) to bring near, touch

plh.g: to work, till; to serve, worship

shbq.g: to leave, let go; to forgive

rwm.g: to be high; (Itpe'el) to be lifted up

avr.g: to pass, cross; (Af'el) to cause to pass

tkl.g: to be bereaved; (Itpe'el) to be bereft (of)

el.g: God (a Hebrew word kept by Onkelos in אֵל עִלָּאָה)
